research_findings: Discovered that the Next.js static build process was failing (ECONNREFUSED) when generating the sitemap due to it trying to fetch from the database during static generation without a live connection.
Identified a missing rate limit on the waitlist signup action which was marked with a TODO comment.
features_improved: Optimized Next.js build process by converting sitemap generation to be dynamically fetched (force-dynamic), preventing build-time database connection failures.
Improved the waitlist signup system by adding an in-memory rate limiter with periodic cleanup.
new_features_added: Introduced an in-memory rate limiter utility (src/lib/rate-limit.ts) that uses a Map to track request counts by IP, equipped with a safe setInterval cleanup mechanism.
next_steps_for_next_run: Implement a Redis-based rate limiter to support distributed deployment environments.
Review other server actions for missing rate limiting.
